weapons.name: Death Sickle
weapons.source: Dropped by Reapers (Solar Eclipse)
weapons.why: Fires a wall-piercing spinning sickle projectile on each swing.

weapons.name: Red's Throw
weapons.source: Any Hardmode boss's Expert/Master Treasure Bag (except Queen Slime), as part of Red's set
weapons.why: Expert-exclusive developer yoyo from Hardmode boss Treasure Bags.

weapons.name: Yelets
weapons.source: 1/200 drop from Hardmode Jungle enemies after any mechanical boss is defeated
weapons.why: Hardmode Jungle drop available after a mechanical boss.

weapons.name: Light Disc
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril/Orichalcum Anvil from Hallowed Bars, Souls of Light, and Souls of Might
weapons.why: Bouncing disc requiring Souls of Might from the Destroyer.

weapons.name: Chlorophyte Claymore
weapons.source: Crafted (Chlorophyte Bars)
weapons.why: Occasionally fires a piercing Chlorophyte Orb when swung.

weapons.name: Chlorophyte Saber
weapons.source: Crafted (Chlorophyte Bars)
weapons.why: Occasionally fires a wall-piercing Spore Cloud when swung.

weapons.name: Adamantite Glaive
weapons.source: Crafted from 12 Adamantite Bars at a Mythril/Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.why: Adamantite-tier Hardmode spear.

weapons.name: Adamantite Sword
weapons.source: Crafted (Adamantite Bars)
weapons.why: Third-tier Hardmode ore broadsword forged from Adamantite.

weapons.name: Brand of the Inferno
weapons.source: Dropped by Ogres (Old One's Army)
weapons.why: Dropped by Ogres; allows shield parrying and inflicts Hellfire.

weapons.name: Chlorophyte Partisan
weapons.source: Crafted from 12 Chlorophyte Bars at a Mythril/Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.why: Chlorophyte spear that releases homing leaf crystals.

weapons.name: Excalibur
weapons.source: Crafted (Hallowed Bars)
weapons.why: Crafted from Hallowed Bars after a mechanical boss.

weapons.name: Ghastly Glaive
weapons.source: Dropped by the Ogre in the Old One's Army (Tier 2, post-mechanical boss)
weapons.why: Ogre drop from the Old One's Army after a mechanical boss.

weapons.name: Gungnir
weapons.source: Crafted from 12 Hallowed Bars at a Mythril/Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.why: Hallowed Bar spear crafted after defeating a mechanical boss.

weapons.name: Mushroom Spear
weapons.source: Purchased from the Truffle after any mechanical boss is defeated
weapons.why: Truffle-sold spear that emits mushroom projectiles, available post-mech boss.

weapons.name: Titanium Sword
weapons.source: Crafted (Titanium Bars)
weapons.why: Titanium-ore equivalent of the Adamantite Sword.

weapons.name: Titanium Trident
weapons.source: Crafted from 13 Titanium Bars at a Mythril/Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.why: Titanium-tier spear crafted at the higher-tier anvil.

weapons.name: Code 2
weapons.source: Bought from the Traveling Merchant after a mechanical boss is defeated
weapons.why: Traveling Merchant yoyo unlocked after any mechanical boss.

weapons.name: Valkyrie Yoyo
weapons.source: Any Hardmode boss's Expert/Master Treasure Bag (except Queen Slime), as part of Lazure's set
weapons.why: Expert-exclusive developer yoyo from Hardmode boss Treasure Bags.

weapons.name: True Excalibur
weapons.source: Crafted (Excalibur + Broken Hero Sword)
weapons.why: Fires a projectile on swing; needs post-Plantera Broken Hero Sword.

weapons.name: True Night's Edge
weapons.source: Crafted (Night's Edge + Broken Hero Sword)
weapons.why: Fires a spinning projectile on swing; needs Broken Hero Sword.

weapons.name: Drippler Crippler
weapons.source: Dropped by Blood Eels (Hardmode Blood Moon)
weapons.why: Hardmode Blood Moon flail dropped by Blood Eels.

weapons.name: Fetid Baghnakhs
weapons.source: Dropped by Crimson Mimics
weapons.why: Extremely fast, very short-range broadsword from Crimson Mimics.

weapons.name: Shadowflame Knife
weapons.source: Dropped by Goblin Warlocks during a Hardmode Goblin Army
weapons.why: Throws ricocheting knives that inflict the Shadowflame debuff.

weapons.name: Gradient
weapons.source: Bought from the Skeleton Merchant during moon phases 1-4 (Hardmode)
weapons.why: Hardmode Skeleton Merchant yoyo sold on full-moon-side phases.

weapons.name: Bananarang
weapons.source: Dropped by Clowns during a Hardmode Blood Moon
weapons.why: Multiple can be thrown at once; dropped by Hardmode Clowns.

weapons.name: Bladetongue
weapons.source: Fished in the Crimson (Hardmode)
weapons.why: Fires an ichor spray projectile on swing and inflicts Ichor.

armor.name: Chlorophyte Armor
armor.why: The leaf crystal bonus and strong baseline stats make this the most broadly useful pre-Plantera melee set.

armor.name: Turtle Armor
armor.source: Crafted from Turtle Shells and Chlorophyte Bars
armor.why: If you want the tankiest route into the Jungle, this is the defensive ceiling before Plantera.

armor.name: Hallowed Armor
armor.why: The dodge proc still gives it real value if your Chlorophyte route is not ready yet.

accessories.name: Fire Gauntlet
accessories.source: Combined at the Tinkerer's Workshop
accessories.why: This is the best melee accessory of the phase because it stacks several offensive bonuses into one clean slot.

accessories.name: Mechanical Glove
accessories.source: Combined at the Tinkerer's Workshop
accessories.why: It is both a real accessory in its own right and the natural stepping stone toward Fire Gauntlet.

accessories.name: Avenger Emblem
accessories.source: Combined from a class emblem and mech-boss materials
accessories.why: A universal damage boost stays useful no matter which exact melee weapon family you lean into.

accessories.name: Mid-Hardmode Wings
accessories.source: Crafted or obtained from established Hardmode wing routes
accessories.why: Flight is still mandatory because Jungle movement and Plantera prep punish grounded loadouts.

accessories.name: Ankh Shield
accessories.source: Combined at the Tinkerer's Workshop
accessories.why: Debuff immunity and knockback protection are especially comforting once Jungle enemies and events get more chaotic.

accessories.name: Star Veil
accessories.source: Crafted from Cross Necklace and Star Cloak.
accessories.why: Longer invincibility after a hit, plus retaliating falling stars.

buffs.name: Flask of Ichor
buffs.why: The defense reduction is too strong to ignore, which makes this the best melee weapon imbue for the phase.

buffs.name: Ironskin Potion
buffs.why: Even with stronger armor, the baseline defense boost is still valuable in every meaningful fight.

buffs.name: Endurance Potion
buffs.why: Damage reduction remains one of the best ways to make difficult Jungle and event attempts more forgiving.

buffs.name: Wrath Potion
buffs.why: A direct damage increase helps shorten fights where melee still has to spend time in danger.

weapons.name: Chlorophyte Shotbow
weapons.source: Crafted from Chlorophyte Bars
weapons.why: Can fire up to four arrows at once when held.

weapons.name: Pulse Bow
weapons.source: Purchased from the Traveling Merchant after defeating all three mechanical bosses
weapons.why: Fires a piercing pulse arrow that bounces off blocks.

weapons.name: Tsunami
weapons.source: Dropped by Duke Fishron
weapons.why: Fires five arrows in a spread from a single arrow.

weapons.name: Megashark
weapons.source: Crafted (Minishark + Illegal Gun Parts + 5 Shark Fin + 20 Souls of Might)
weapons.why: Post-Destroyer upgrade to the Minishark requiring Souls of Might from a mechanical boss.

weapons.name: Adamantite Repeater
weapons.source: Crafted from Adamantite Bars
weapons.why: Third-tier Hardmode repeater crafted at a Mythril/Orichalcum Anvil.

weapons.name: Hallowed Repeater
weapons.source: Crafted from Hallowed Bars (mechanical boss drops)
weapons.why: Crafted from Hallowed Bars dropped by the mechanical bosses.

weapons.name: Phantom Phoenix
weapons.source: Dropped by the Ogre (Tier 2 Old One's Army)
weapons.why: Periodically fires an extra spectral phoenix arrow.

weapons.name: Titanium Repeater
weapons.source: Crafted from Titanium Bars
weapons.why: Titanium equivalent of the Adamantite Repeater.

weapons.name: Flamethrower
weapons.source: Crafted (20 Iron Bars + Illegal Gun Parts + 20 Souls of Fright)
weapons.why: Sprays a continuous cone of fire fuelled by Gel.

weapons.name: Super Star Shooter
weapons.source: Crafted (Star Cannon + 12 Hallowed Bars)
weapons.why: Hallowed upgrade to the Star Cannon.

weapons.name: Beenade
weapons.source: Dropped by Queen Bee; crafted with Bee Wax from Queen Bee
weapons.why: A Queen Bee consumable that releases homing bees on detonation.

weapons.name: Daedalus Stormbow
weapons.source: Dropped by Hallowed Mimics
weapons.why: Fires arrows that rain down from the sky.

weapons.name: Star Cannon
weapons.source: Crafted (Minishark + 20 Meteorite Bars + 5 Fallen Stars)
weapons.why: Fires Fallen Stars for exceptional pre-Hardmode damage.

weapons.name: Barrel Launcher
weapons.source: Dropped by pirates during a Pirate Invasion
weapons.why: Lobs explosive barrels in an arc.

armor.name: Chlorophyte Armor
armor.why: The armor stats and leaf crystal bonus make this the cleanest general pre-Plantera ranger set.

armor.name: Hallowed Armor
armor.why: The dodge effect still earns this a place when survivability matters more than a pure offense step.

armor.name: Titanium Armor
armor.why: It remains a valid carry-over if you want to delay the Chlorophyte grind a little longer.

accessories.name: Sniper Scope
accessories.source: Combined at the Tinkerer's Workshop
accessories.why: This is the premium ranger accessory here because it boosts ranged performance while also improving target control.

accessories.name: Ranger Emblem
accessories.source: Dropped by the Wall of Flesh
accessories.why: A direct ranged-damage boost is still an easy slot-in when your weapon options are already strong.

accessories.name: Magic Quiver
accessories.source: Dropped by Skeleton Archers
accessories.why: Bow-focused ranger builds still feel the damage and arrow-speed bump immediately.

accessories.name: Mid-Hardmode Wings
accessories.source: Crafted or obtained from established Hardmode wing routes
accessories.why: Ranger uptime depends on movement consistency, and this phase keeps punishing grounded play.

accessories.name: Ankh Shield
accessories.source: Combined at the Tinkerer's Workshop
accessories.why: Debuff immunity is particularly welcome once Jungle enemies start layering crowd-control on top of boss pressure.

accessories.name: Star Veil
accessories.source: Crafted from Cross Necklace and Star Cloak.
accessories.why: Longer invincibility after a hit, plus retaliating falling stars.

buffs.name: Archery Potion
buffs.why: The research consistently calls this out as the best dedicated ranger buff in the phase.

buffs.name: Ammo Reservation Potion
buffs.why: Ammo efficiency matters once your best ammo types and long boss attempts start stacking up in cost.

buffs.name: Ammo Box
buffs.why: It is effectively free ranged value before any important fight and stacks nicely with the potion support.

buffs.name: Endurance Potion
buffs.why: Even ranged builds benefit a lot from damage reduction once the Jungle starts punishing mistakes harder.

weapons.name: Tome of Infinite Wisdom
weapons.source: Dropped by Ogres during Tier 2 Old One's Army (requires one mechanical boss)
weapons.why: Fires bursts of pages, or with right-click a large piercing tornado.

weapons.name: Magical Harp
weapons.source: Crafted (1 Harp + 20 Crystal Shards + 8 Souls of Night + 15 Souls of Sight @ Mythril/Orichalcum Anvil)
weapons.why: Fires music-note projectiles whose damage scales with velocity.

weapons.name: Rainbow Rod
weapons.source: Crafted (10 Crystal Shards + 2 Unicorn Horns + 10 Pixie Dust + 8 Souls of Light + 15 Souls of Sight @ Mythril/Orichalcum Anvil)
weapons.why: Fires a cursor-controlled rainbow projectile that pierces enemies.

weapons.name: Toxic Flask
weapons.source: Dropped by Dr. Man Fly (Solar Eclipse, post-mechanical boss)
weapons.why: Throws a flask that bursts into a lingering cloud inflicting Venom.

weapons.name: Venom Staff
weapons.source: Crafted (Poison Staff + 14 Chlorophyte Bars @ Mythril/Orichalcum Anvil)
weapons.why: Upgraded Poison Staff whose fang inflicts the stronger Venom debuff.

weapons.name: Shadowflame Hex Doll
weapons.source: Dropped by Goblin Warlocks (Hardmode Goblin Army)
weapons.why: Fires homing shadowflame bolts that inflict the Shadowflame debuff.

weapons.name: Orange Zapinator
weapons.source: Purchased from the Traveling Merchant (Hardmode)
weapons.why: Fires an erratic light beam with high random damage variance.

weapons.name: Life Drain
weapons.source: Dropped by Crimson Mimics
weapons.why: Channels a homing beam that heals the player as it damages enemies.

weapons.name: Spirit Flame
weapons.source: Crafted (Desert Spirit Lamp + 2 Forbidden Fragment + 12 Soul of Night @ Mythril/Orichalcum Anvil)
weapons.why: Summons homing spirit flames that circle before striking enemies.

weapons.name: Unholy Trident
weapons.source: Dropped by Red Devils (Underworld, Hardmode)
weapons.why: Fires a spectral trident that passes through blocks.

weapons.name: Clinger Staff
weapons.source: Dropped by Corrupt Mimics (1/5) in the Hardmode Underground Corruption
weapons.why: Generates a lasting wall of Cursed Flame that damages and inflicts Cursed Inferno on enemies passing through.

weapons.name: Nimbus Rod
weapons.source: Dropped by Angry Nimbus (1/15) during rain in Hardmode
weapons.why: Spawns up to two lasting storm clouds that drop damaging rain projectiles below them.

weapons.name: Crystal Storm
weapons.source: Crafted (Spell Tome + Crystal Shards) at a Bookcase
weapons.why: Hallow counterpart that rapidly fires small bouncing crystal shards.

armor.name: Chlorophyte Armor
armor.why: This is the most straightforward high-end magic armor step before Plantera because it is sturdy and broadly effective.

armor.name: Hallowed Armor
armor.why: The dodge effect is still strong when you care more about safety than pushing fully into Chlorophyte.

armor.name: Forbidden Armor
armor.source: Crafted from Forbidden Fragments and Adamantite or Titanium Bars
armor.why: The hybrid identity keeps it relevant if your build likes mixing in summon support or event mobility.

accessories.name: Celestial Emblem
accessories.source: Combined at the Tinkerer's Workshop
accessories.why: It is the cleanest mage accessory upgrade here because it boosts damage while smoothing mana utility at the same time.

accessories.name: Celestial Cuffs
accessories.source: Combined at the Tinkerer's Workshop
accessories.why: The mana-on-hit effect helps salvage otherwise doomed attempts when a boss pattern catches you.

accessories.name: Mana Flower
accessories.source: Combined at the Tinkerer's Workshop
accessories.why: Auto-potions reduce cognitive load and keep your strongest spells online more consistently.

accessories.name: Mid-Hardmode Wings
accessories.source: Crafted or obtained from established Hardmode wing routes
accessories.why: Flight still buys mage the room it needs to cast safely through difficult Jungle and event movement.

accessories.name: Ankh Shield
accessories.source: Combined at the Tinkerer's Workshop
accessories.why: Debuff immunity is a real quality-of-life and survivability gain once the Jungle starts stacking status effects.

accessories.name: Mana Cloak
accessories.source: Crafted from Mana Flower and Star Cloak.
accessories.why: Auto mana potions plus a defensive star burst when you take a hit.

buffs.name: Magic Power Potion
buffs.why: It remains the most direct and valuable magic buff you can bring into this phase.

buffs.name: Mana Regeneration Potion
buffs.why: Longer fights and higher-tier spells both make mana sustain more important than it was before.

buffs.name: Crystal Ball
buffs.source: Placed station buff from the Wizard
buffs.why: It is free pre-fight magic value, so there is little reason to skip it once available.

buffs.name: Ironskin Potion
buffs.why: Mage still benefits from a simple defensive floor because burst damage remains a constant threat.

weapons.name: Optic Staff
weapons.source: Crafted from Black Lens + 2 Lens + 12 Hallowed Bars + 20 Souls of Sight at a Mythril/Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.why: Summons Twins (Retanimini and Spazmamini) as one minion; needs Souls of Sight from The Twins.

weapons.name: Ballista Cane
weapons.source: Bought from the Tavernkeep after defeating one mechanical boss (tier 2)
weapons.why: Tier 2 Tavernkeep upgrade of the ballista bolt sentry.

weapons.name: Durendal
weapons.source: Crafted (12 Hallowed Bar at a Mythril/Orichalcum Anvil)
weapons.why: Hallowed Bar whip with fast use time that boosts minion attack speed.

weapons.name: Pirate Staff
weapons.source: Dropped by Pirates and the Flying Dutchman during the Pirate Invasion
weapons.why: Summons a Pirate minion; obtained from the Hardmode Pirate Invasion event.

weapons.name: Explosive Trap Cane
weapons.source: Bought from the Tavernkeep after defeating one mechanical boss (tier 2)
weapons.why: Tier 2 Tavernkeep upgrade of the explosive trap sentry.

weapons.name: Flameburst Cane
weapons.source: Bought from the Tavernkeep after defeating one mechanical boss (tier 2)
weapons.why: Tier 2 Tavernkeep upgrade of the flameburst fireball sentry.

weapons.name: Lightning Aura Cane
weapons.source: Bought from the Tavernkeep after defeating one mechanical boss (tier 2)
weapons.why: Tier 2 Tavernkeep upgrade of the lightning aura sentry.

weapons.name: Queen Spider Staff
weapons.source: Crafted from 24 Spider Fang at a Mythril/Orichalcum Anvil (Hardmode)
weapons.why: Early Hardmode sentry summoning a Spider Turret that lobs bouncing egg projectiles.

weapons.name: Sanguine Staff
weapons.source: Dropped by Dreadnautilus (Blood Moon fishing in Hardmode)
weapons.why: Summons fast Sanguine Bat minions; obtainable early Hardmode with no mechanical boss required.

weapons.name: Spider Staff
weapons.source: Crafted from 16 Spider Fangs at a Mythril/Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.why: Summons Spider minions that inflict Acid Venom; Spider Fangs drop from Hardmode Black Recluses.

weapons.name: Abigail's Flower
weapons.source: Found growing on grass near a placed Tombstone
weapons.why: Summons Abigail, a single ghost minion that grows stronger with each re-summon.

weapons.name: Firecracker
weapons.source: Dropped by the Wall of Flesh
weapons.why: Wall of Flesh drop whose tag detonates for a large burst of minion damage.

weapons.name: Blade Staff
weapons.source: Dropped by Queen Slime
weapons.why: Summons Enchanted Dagger minions with low base damage that ignore 25 defense, scaling on flat/tag bonuses.

weapons.name: Cool Whip
weapons.source: Crafted (8 Soul of Light + 8 Soul of Night + 1 Frost Core at a Mythril/Orichalcum Anvil)
weapons.why: Summons a Frost Wave and applies Frostburn to struck enemies.

weapons.name: Barnacle Staff
weapons.source: Rare catch when fishing in the Hardmode Jungle (any layer)
weapons.why: Hardmode fished sentry summoning a hanging barnacle that poisons enemies.

armor.name: Spider Armor
armor.why: Until post-Plantera armor opens up, this is still the cleanest dedicated summoner set for raw minion throughput.

armor.name: Hallowed Armor
armor.why: The dodge bonus gives it a niche if you want more personal survivability while keeping summon support online.

armor.name: Forbidden Armor
armor.source: Crafted from Forbidden Fragments and Adamantite or Titanium Bars
armor.why: It stays a viable hybrid route if your build wants a little more flexibility than pure summoner gear provides.

accessories.name: Summoner Emblem
accessories.source: Dropped by the Wall of Flesh
accessories.why: This is still the easiest and most efficient direct summon-damage upgrade available in the phase.

accessories.name: Pygmy Necklace
accessories.source: Bought from the Witch Doctor
accessories.why: An extra minion slot remains one of the highest-value single accessory effects a summoner can get.

accessories.name: Mid-Hardmode Wings
accessories.source: Crafted or obtained from established Hardmode wing routes
accessories.why: You still win summon fights by staying alive long enough for minions and whips to do their work.

accessories.name: Feral Claws
accessories.source: Found in Jungle chests or Jungle Crates
accessories.why: The whip speed boost remains a simple but noticeable improvement to the part of summoner gameplay you actively pilot.

accessories.name: Ankh Shield
accessories.source: Combined at the Tinkerer's Workshop
accessories.why: Debuff immunity and knockback protection reduce the number of runs that fall apart to messy Jungle attrition.

accessories.name: Star Veil
accessories.source: Crafted from Cross Necklace and Star Cloak.
accessories.why: Longer invincibility after a hit, plus retaliating falling stars.

buffs.name: Summoning Potion
buffs.why: An extra minion is still the single best buff you can bring to a summoner loadout in this phase.

buffs.name: Bewitching Table
buffs.source: Placed station buff from the Dungeon
buffs.why: It stacks perfectly with your potion support and should be part of every serious summon setup.

buffs.name: Ironskin Potion
buffs.why: Summoner is still fragile enough that the universal defense potion remains mandatory in practice.

buffs.name: Endurance Potion
buffs.why: Damage reduction buys the breathing room you need while your minions and whips ramp up real damage.
